God Mindustry is such a hidden gem! Pick it up if you like RTS, management, or automation games. Hybrid game between factorio-like base building gameplay and creating RTS units with said base. Currently has two(?)(at the time of writing this) entire campaigns packed full of content and plenty of custom maps and user created content to keep you going for a while. Very very good! (more people need to know about this good game goddamnit! (It's even on mobile!!) 

Warning: as with all games in the Factory/Automation genre (especially this one), I would say playing this game is the closest you can get to taking crack without actually doing so. Be careful with that free time! Also please remember to take showers from time to time.

I played this game for like 3 years for free off of the mindustry itch.io thingy, but after some very careful consideration, my cheap ahh bought the game because it is truly worth it, there is no better deal. The updates are looking so good for the game in the future, and considering it's single dev, I would 100% recommend paying the 10 bucks.

Addictiveness of this game in honestly paranormal. Probably it's because of simplistic visual design, which give a rather false sense of casuality. "Oh I can beat it easily! Just build some pumps here, wall there, a turret here, mining, some power grid all over the place.."

It's 3 a.m. You have no clue how you got there. You spent last eternity placing conveyor belts and battery racks.

Somehow you're totally fine with it.

Игра полное дерьмо, если вы в нее зайдете то все ваши клетки мозга взорвутся вместе с ториевыми реакторами. В попе будет больно когда у тебя волны идут раз в минуту 56 врагов и каждые 30 сек тебе на ядро ползет т4 кладя хер на твою оборону и обнуляя 8 часов твоей жизни. Игра класс рекомендую

I really like this games campagne since I knew it allready on my phone where there was only one planet. The only thing that makes me sad is that I can't start playing on my PC and continue my progress on my phone via Steamcloud becouse you have to install it from playstore. A cooperation between those two platforms would probably make my sadness go away. It's not only this game every game that is also available on the phone has the same issue. Like Marvel Snap for example. I know it's hard to implement but it would still be great. Yeah, so this game is THE factory game of All time. The game the myth the Legend the classic. And I didn't evem mention the mods, which you can install in the game itself and only have to restart it.

Peak Factory-Building-RTS-Tower-Defense game.

Лучшая игра, в которую я когда-либо играл. Реиграбельность чрезвычайно высокая за счёт модов и пользовательского контента. Я лично никогда не любил сервера и игру со случайными людьми. Пусть в Steam на данный момент наиграно только 31 час, на деле я играю уже очень давно - и на телефоне, и на ПК. FPS крайне стабильный даже с несколькими десятками модов и при долгой пользовательской игре. К сожалению, мне мало с кем есть играть, так как из друзей, кто может со мной поиграть в Mindustry, только один ;(. Но игра будет абсолютно всегда легендарной стратегией с элементами tower defense. Желаю Anuke успехов в развитии этой игры - впечатления от неё у меня сохранятся навсегда.
